title: Our history - Windau
content: # Our history. # From the beginning ... We have been writing our history since 1976: back then, our company was founded when Clemens Hilker took over the small Windau country butcher's shop in Harsewinkel, East Westphalia. Even after a move from the original headquarters in the city centre to our current plant, we remain rooted in **Harsewinkel in the heart of East Westphalia** to the present day. As a family business, **Windau is now run by the second generation**. Through continuous growth, we have developed into one of the most modern production facilities in Europe with around 350 employees. With an operating area of approx. 25,000 m2 and a production volume of approx. 20,000 metric tons annually, we achieve an annual turnover of 100 million euros (2023). Our above-average export share of 25% underlines our international activities. This makes us one of the **top 100 companies** in the German meat industry today.

title: Gaomi | CLAAS
content: # The factory in China's breadbasket. We have had a site in the city of Gaomi in eastern China since 2014. The factory produces high-quality agricultural machines and manufactures components to the same standard as German suppliers. It owes its success to Germany's dual system of vocational training and education and the CLAAS corporate philosophy, which the Chinese employees have embraced more than 8,000 kilometres away from our headquarters in Harsewinkel. It's still quiet at the factory in the Chinese city of Gaomi at seven in the morning. The idea behind this is simple: the production of CLAAS agricultural machinery requires the highest quality standards to be upheld – and that works best when everyone on site pulls together. These changes to the corporate culture in recent years have contributed to the success of the production plant. The city with 900,000 inhabitants – quite small by Chinese standards – is in the Shandong Province, one of China's main agricultural regions and known as the breadbasket of China.

title: Change of name of four subsidiaries of Wirthwein AG
content: # Change of name of four subsidiaries of Wirthwein AG. **As of July 1st, 2020 four subsidiaries of Wirthwein AG will be renamed. Altogether four companies in three different countries are concerned by the change of name, in Germany, Spain, and the USA, where it concerns both Wirthwein plants in North Carolina and South Carolina.**. Marcus Wirthwein explains the reasons for the change of names:  “We want to further strengthen our position as a leading manufacturer of plastic-based components, assemblies, and systems for innovative key branches“. Dr. Thomas Jakob, head of the Medical Technology business unit and also general manager of the medical technology company headquartered in Mühltal near Darmstadt, argues in favor of a change of name:  “For the business partners of our present Riegler GmbH & Co.
